title: On the Subgaussianity of Quantized Linear Maps: An AI-Assisted Note
summary: We prove an elementary bounded-differences inequality for functions of non-isotropic Gaussian vectors. Specifically, if $f$ has bounded coordinate differences and $X\sim\mathcal N(μ,Σ)$, then the resulting concentration bound depends on the condition number $κ(Σ)$. As an application, we answer a question of Simone Bombari concerning the subgaussianity of sign-quantized linear maps $Y=\mathrm{sgn}(Wx)$.
